title: the Sundered Sea Rising Again
premise: Xanthe Okonkwo, a bone-carver who hears the voices of the dead in the relics he carves, has spent years guiding smugglers through the Thornfell mountains while hiding the truth of his gift. When the drowned old gods of the Sundered Sea begin answering prayers again, their rising floods the mountain passes with magic that tears the veil between realms, and Xanthe's dead sister's voice leads him to a shattered covenant-stone only he can reforge. Torn between loyalty to the smuggler family who raised him — who profit from the broken border between realms — and the truth the dead demand he speak, he must choose. In the end, Xanthe sacrifices his hearing of the dead to seal the new covenant, binding the realms together and finding that the found family who chose him stays anyway.
about_author: Rosalind Whitlock is the pen name of a former cartographer who spent a decade mapping remote coastlines before turning to fiction, and her love of liminal places saturates every page she writes. She lives in a drafty house full of sea-glass, half-finished carvings, and one opinionated cat.

chapters.title: The Voices in the Ivory
chapters.summary: POV: Xanthe. In the smuggling town of Greyhollow, Xanthe finishes carving a memorial bone for a client and hears the dead man speak through it — proof his gift is growing stronger. His adoptive brother Dario warns him to stay quiet; the Thornfell crews fear anything touched by old magic. Emotional beat: lonely competence masking a secret that is becoming impossible to hide.

chapters.title: What the Tide Brought Back
chapters.summary: POV: Xanthe. A prayer answered at the drowned chapel below Greyhollow pulls Xanthe into its flooded crypt, where his dead sister Sefa's voice rises from a fragment of covenant-stone. The old gods are waking, and the barrier between realms is thinning. Emotional beat: grief cracked open by hope — the first voice from Sefa in nine years.

chapters.title: The Crew That Raised Him
chapters.summary: POV: Xanthe. The smuggler found-family gathers: matriarch Odile, sharp-tongued navigator Pell, and young runaway Wren. They plan a high-profit run through a pass now humming with dangerous magic. Xanthe conceals what he heard, torn between telling them the truth and protecting the only family he has. Emotional beat: warmth laced with the first real lie.

chapters.title: A God Answers Wrong
chapters.summary: POV: Wren. A desperate villager's prayer summons something vast and half-remembered that takes Wren's offered name as a claim. Xanthe breaks the bargain with a carved bone-token, revealing his gift to the crew. Odile's reaction is cold: gifts like his once started wars. Emotional beat: belonging threatened by revelation.

chapters.title: The Road Through Thornfell
chapters.summary: POV: Xanthe. Guiding the crew through a pass where the veil bleeds through, Xanthe hears hundreds of dead clamoring about a broken oath made by the first bone-carvers. Dario accuses him of leading them into a trap for the gods' sake. They survive, barely, but trust is bleeding out. Emotional beat: duty to the dead versus loyalty to the living, made literal on the road.

chapters.title: Sefa's Bargain
chapters.summary: POV: Xanthe. Sefa's spirit reveals the covenant was shattered deliberately — by the founders of Greyhollow, including Odile's own grandmother, to free the smuggler clans from divine law. Reforging it will end the free roads forever. Odile offers Xanthe a choice: the crew or the gods. He chooses the road to the covenant-stone alone. Emotional beat: heartbreak disguised as resolve.

chapters.title: Wren Follows
chapters.summary: POV: Wren. Refusing to let him go, Wren trails Xanthe into the high fells, and the two are caught in a realm-storm where the dead walk visibly. Wren learns Xanthe's silence was protection, not betrayal, and chooses him anyway — the found family remade by choice rather than blood. Emotional beat: fierce, hard-won trust.

chapters.title: The Sundered Stone
chapters.summary: POV: Xanthe. At the shattered covenant-stone, the waking god arrives demanding payment, and Dario arrives too — sent by Odile to stop Xanthe at any cost. The brothers clash as the god offers Xanthe Sefa's return in exchange for leaving the stone broken. Emotional beat: the cruelest temptation, love weaponized against duty.

chapters.title: Reforge
chapters.summary: POV: Xanthe. Xanthe refuses the bargain and begins the reforging, which demands a carver give up the sense that grants the work — his hearing of the dead. Sefa's last words release him: she was never his to keep. Dario, seeing his brother's sacrifice, turns to shield him from the god's fury. Emotional beat: sacrifice transfigured into love.

chapters.title: The Sea Rising Again
chapters.summary: POV: Xanthe. The covenant seals; the realms bind in balance, and the smuggler roads close but the clans endure under a new accord Odile grudgingly signs. Deaf now to the dead, Xanthe returns to Greyhollow to find the crew waiting — not because they must, but because they choose. Emotional beat: quiet, earned homecoming; silence filled by the living.
